name: Sora-iro no Organ
source:
In order to save your cousin, who's been sucked into a mirror, you decide to jump into the mirror yourself. You find yourself in a strange, beautiful world of fairies. As you work through the game's storyline, you'll take part in interactive conversations. The game includes an "encore mode" which allows you to view previous event scenes and listen to music that you encountered on your adventure.

[From GameSpy]
translation:
为了拯救被吸入镜中的表亲，你决定自己也跳进镜子。醒来后，你发现自己身处一个奇异而美丽的精灵世界。随着故事推进，你会参与互动对话。游戏还收录“安可模式”，可以回看此前经历过的事件场景，重听冒险途中遇到的音乐。

[摘自GameSpy]
